commitDialog.title: Save a snapshot?
commitDialog.description: Creates a commit with all changes in the local repository (git add -A, git commit). Nothing is uploaded.
commitDialog.subject: Subject
commitDialog.noteHint: Optional; goes into the commit below the subject.

gitInitDialog.title: Set up Git?
gitInitDialog.legalNote: Your project contains data from the game. Do not upload it publicly; to share it, there is the patch (Technical › Publish).
gitInitDialog.description: Creates a local Git repository in this project folder: .gitignore and .gitattributes, then a first commit “Initial state”. Gen4 Studio sets up no remote and uploads nothing.

ignored.textProject: Ignored: ROMs, patches, build/, save games and the game files (they are made from the base ROM)

restoreDialog.title: Complete the text project?
